summary: Browser redirect payload distributed via npm/jsDelivr CDN; no installer-side harm
details: The package ships px.js, a browser-only script that overlays a full-viewport iframe pointing at https://mfmz.yunkeit.cn/H.html?c=0gjr using document.write/createElement. An included update_px8my.sh script rotates the destination domain, bumps the package version, republishes to npm, and purges the jsDelivr CDN cache, indicating the package is used as a mutable redirect payload served through npm→jsDelivr rather than as a Node library. No lifecycle scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall) are declared, and require('px8my') in Node fails because the code references browser globals (document). Installing or requiring this package on a developer or build machine does not execute the redirect, exfiltrate data, fetch remote code, or drop persistence — the harm surface is limited to end users of web pages that embed the jsDelivr URL for this package, which is outside this engine's installer-centric threat model.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
